Project 02 / Personal project

HackPad

A custom control pad. Six keys, a rotary encoder and a small display for everyday shortcuts.

A compact macropad design based on the Seeed XIAO RP2040. Six keys are complemented by an EC11 encoder, an OLED display and addressable LEDs.

The goal is quick access to shortcuts such as copy, paste, save and playback controls. The encoder handles volume. Firmware is designed around KMK; physical hardware validation is a separate next step.
